description: This file defines the SecurityIRClient class for interacting with the Security Incident Response service in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to security incident management.

classes.name: SecurityIRClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Security Incident Response service.

methods.name: batchGetMemberAccountDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for multiple member accounts.

methods.name: createCaseComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a security case.

methods.name: getCase
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific case.

methods.name: getCaseAttachmentDownloadUrl
methods.description: Gets a download URL for a case attachment.

methods.name: getCaseAttachmentUploadUrl
methods.description: Gets an upload URL for a case attachment.

methods.name: listCaseEdits
methods.description: Lists edits made to a case.

methods.name: updateCaseComment
methods.description: Updates a comment on a case.

methods.name: updateCaseStatus

methods.name: updateResolverType
methods.description: Updates the resolver type for a case.
